command:
set -euo pipefail; revision=5642f169a72eccd8615e284816db63a75a0a18c1; branch=$(git branch --show-current); default_branch=main; git fetch --prune origin >/dev/null; test "$branch" = fix/rune-scribe-remediation-v1; test -z "$(git tag --points-at "$revision")"; if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$revision" "origin/$default_branch"; then exit 1; fi; releases=$(gh release list --repo flynn33/rune-scribe --limit 100 --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,publishedAt); runs=$(gh run list --repo flynn33/rune-scribe --branch "$branch" --limit 20 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,event,workflowName,headSha); printf 'REMOTE_RELEASES=%s
REMOTE_BRANCH_RUNS=%s
DEFAULT_BRANCH=%s
BRANCH=%s
SOURCE_REVISION=%s
PUBLICATION_AUDIT_PASS
REMOTE_INSPECTION_PERFORMED=true
HEAD_TAGS=NONE
SOURCE_MERGED_TO_DEFAULT=false
RELEASE_PUBLISHED=false
UPLOAD_PERFORMED=false
NOTARIZATION_PERFORMED=false
TESTFLIGHT_PERFORMED=false
APPSTORE_PERFORMED=false
ROLLOUT_PERFORMED=false
' "$releases" "$runs" "$default_branch" "$branch" "$revision"
